chapter: Ch. 6 — Measuring What Matters (Fig. 6.2, book p. 126)
evidence: Figure art (rendered PDF p. 150) labels the red vertical line "SLO 2 s (TTFT budget)". The caption on the same page states the line is "the 2 s request-latency line — the p95 TTFT ceiling (Ch 4, Table 4-1 Latency row; Canonical Workload box), not the 1.2 s design budget". Ch. 4 (PDF p. 112-113) states: "The two thresholds are not interchangeable: 1.2 s is the design budget, ≤ 2 s is the p95 ceiling the budget relaxes to, and any pass/fail judgement on a measured distribution is made against the p95 ceiling, not the budget."
issue: The in-figure label identifies the 2 s p95 ceiling as the "TTFT budget", directly contradicting the caption beneath it and the book's load-bearing budget-vs-ceiling convention (1.2 s = design budget; 2 s = p95 pass/fail ceiling). Unlike Fig. 6.1, whose art erratum (the 'concurrency' entry) is explicitly acknowledged in its caption, this art/caption mismatch is not flagged anywhere.
fix_instruction: Change the figure label to "SLO 2 s (p95 TTFT ceiling)" so the art matches the caption and the Ch. 4 convention; optionally add an erratum note in the caption mirroring the treatment given to Fig. 6.1's art erratum.
